stories.title: Le gouvernement français promet davantage de professeurs, alors que 71'500 personnes manifestent

en.title: French government promises more teachers as 71,500 people protest
en.summary: France's education minister announced the imminent arrival of 3,000 replacement teachers to over 500 secondary schools facing critical staffing shortages, following renewed student protests amid urban unrest.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Trumps zweite Amtszeit: Verteidigungsminister Hegseth will öffentliche Hinrichtung von Attentäter

en.title: Latest developments - Trump's second term: defense minister Hegseth wants public execution of attacker
en.summary: Donald Trump is serving his second presidential term with significant domestic and foreign policy consequences. The defense minister has proposed public execution as a response to an attack.

stories.title: Le porte-avions USS Abraham Lincoln est de retour aux Etats-Unis après un déploiement mouvementé au Moyen-Orient

en.title: Aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returns to United States after turbulent Middle East deployment
en.summary: The nuclear-powered USS Abraham Lincoln returned to its San Diego home port after a nine-month deployment to the Middle East marked by difficult living conditions and crew suicide attempts.

stories.title: "On est le jour d'après": Hugo Duminil-Copin face au bouleversement des mathématiques par l'IA

en.title: "We are the day after": Fields medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin faces mathematics transformed by AI
en.summary: Following OpenAI's release of extensive mathematical proofs, Fields medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin described the development as a monumental shock while calling for preservation of human understanding, knowledge transfer, and creativity.

en.title: Urbs's Drawing (France)
en.summary: A cartoon by Urbs, a regular contributor to Canard enchaîné and Le Monde, depicts the controversy surrounding alleged antisemitic remarks attributed to Bardella. The work was selected by Chappatte in collaboration with Cartooning for Peace and the Freedom Cartoonists foundation.

stories.title: Le CHUV suspend et dénonce un chirurgien soupçonné d’avoir falsifié des documents médicaux

en.title: CHUV Suspends and Denounces Surgeon Suspected of Falsifying Medical Documents
en.summary: A senior physician at CHUV's plastic and reconstructive surgery department has been suspended for forging operative reports by adding his signature despite not being present during procedures. The hospital has reported the matter to the Vaud prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Granit Xhaka ist wegen eines gefälschten Covid-Zertifikats verurteilt worden – nun folgen Gespräche mit dem Verband

en.title: Granit Xhaka Has Been Sentenced for a Forged Covid Certificate – Now Discussions Follow with the Federation
en.summary: The Swiss national team captain received a conditional fine from the Lucerne prosecutor's office for using a forged Covid certificate. Xhaka announced the verdict himself on Instagram.

stories.title: Documents médicaux falsifiés: un chirurgien du CHUV suspendu et dénoncé à la justice

en.title: Falsified medical documents: a CHUV surgeon suspended and reported to justice
en.summary: A surgeon at CHUV was suspended and reported to authorities after internal investigation discovered falsified medical documents in the plastic and reconstructive surgery department.

stories.title: Pourquoi il ne faut pas prendre trop au sérieux Ramon Vega, éternel candidat à la présidence de la FIFA

en.title: Why Ramon Vega Should Not Be Taken Too Seriously, the Eternal Candidate for FIFA Presidency
en.summary: The 55-year-old former Swiss defender announced his candidacy for FIFA presidency in 2027, with elections scheduled for Rabat in March. His history as an enigmatic and colorful figure raises questions about his credibility as a serious candidate.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Machtkampf in der Fifa: Jetzt will der Schweizer Ramon Vega Präsident werden

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Power struggle at FIFA: Swiss Ramon Vega now wants to become president
en.summary: The battle for the FIFA presidency has intensified since the summer 2026 World Cup, with the presidential election scheduled for March. Recent developments and background information are outlined.

stories.title: Swiss footballer Granit Xhaka faces probation for fake Covid certificate

en.title: Swiss footballer Granit Xhaka faces probation for fake Covid certificate
en.summary: Swiss national team captain Granit Xhaka received a two-year probation and was fined 150,000 CHF after admitting to obtaining a fake vaccination certificate during the pandemic. He stated he accepts the decision and takes responsibility for his actions.

stories.title: Bedingte Geldstrafe – Granit Xhaka wegen gefälschtem Covid-Zertifikat verurteilt

en.title: Conditional fine – Granit Xhaka convicted for forged Covid certificate
en.summary: Football player Granit Xhaka has been convicted and received a conditional fine for using a forged Covid certificate. He confirmed the conviction through a statement on his Instagram account.

stories.title: Die deutsche Wirtschaft wächst stärker als erwartet. Es gibt aber ein Problem

en.title: German economy grows stronger than expected. But there is a problem
en.summary: Germany's government projects 2026 GDP growth of 1.3 percent, more than double its previous forecast. Business associations nonetheless demand that promised economic reforms be implemented.

stories.title: Die reichen Teens und Twens der Generation Z geben doppelt so viel Geld für Kunst aus wie ältere Generationen

en.title: Wealthy Generation Z teens and young adults spend twice as much money on art as older generations
en.summary: Young affluent members of Generation Z purchase significantly more art than their older counterparts. Family connections serve as the primary gateway into the art market, according to research by Arts Economics and UBS.

stories.title: Die deutsche Bundeswehr wäre im Drohnenkrieg nicht auf der Höhe der Zeit. So will sie von der Ukraine lernen

en.title: German Bundeswehr would not be up to date in drone warfare. This is how it wants to learn from Ukraine
en.summary: Drone use significantly reshapes modern military operations. Germany aims to close its capability gap by having an entire military unit test new drone systems.

stories.title: Donald Trump nutzte Steuergelder für Eigenwerbung. Jetzt krebst er zurück, aber die Kontroverse läuft weiter

en.title: Donald Trump used taxpayer money for self-promotion. Now he is backing down, but the controversy continues
en.summary: Advertising films were intended to show Americans the country's successes under Trump. However, the controversy over the president initially charging campaign costs to taxpayers threatens to overshadow this message.

stories.title: Überall leere Kassen: China hat die Jagd auf die Reichen des Landes freigegeben

en.title: Empty coffers everywhere: China has unleashed the hunt for the country's wealthy
en.summary: As state revenues decline, China's government is targeting wealthy citizens through legal and questionable methods, causing unrest among millionaires.
